Learned counsel, Mr. M. Kumar & associates  have entered appearance on behalf of the Informant by filing vakalatnama.
The same is taken on record.
2. Name of learned counsel Mr. M. Kumar & associates be reflected in the file, cause list as well as Web Portal of this Court.

3. Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner, learned counsel for the State and learned counsel for the Informant.
4. The Petitioner is seeking pre-arrest bail in connection with C.T. Case No.911 of 2025 pending in the Court of learned J.M.F.C.-III, Bhubaneswar arising out of Nayapalli P.S. Case No.429 of 2025 for commission of offence punishable under Section 420 of IPC.
5.

Learned counsel appearing for the Informant submits that the Petitioner has criminal proclivity and he relies on the FIRs filed in the said context, copies of which has been annexed in the memo which is taken on record.
Learned counsel for the Informant undertakes to serve copy of the said FIRs in which the Petitioner has been cited as accused on the learned counsel for the State as well as Petitioner by 08.09.2025.
